integrity.uncertainties: A previously unindexed equivalent specialization of the general graph-state symmetry criterion cannot be excluded.

scientific_limitations: The exact classification concerns one-copy graph-basis-preserving tensor products of one-qubit Clifford operators on a fixed, vertex-labelled hypercube, modulo local Paulis and overall phase.
The theorem does not cover graph automorphism permutations, nonlocal gates, arbitrary local unitaries, noisy protocol performance, or independent priority certification.
The general local-Clifford symplectic criterion is existing literature; originality is claimed only for the evaluated all-hypercube classification, not for that criterion.
title: Exact local-Clifford graph-basis symmetry groups of all hypercubes
